title: Endgame texts
doc: Texts shown when the game ends, chosen by name, each in three languages.

sections.doc: Entries found by searching for the exact text $Name:; under each, En:, Gr: and Fr: start plain text blocks that end at #end.

fields.name: $Name:
fields.doc: Endgame name used by the level event that ends the game.

fields.name: En:
fields.doc: English text lines up to a line that is exactly #end (any case) or the end of the file; read by an English game.

fields.name: Gr:
fields.doc: German text lines, ended like En:; only a German game reads it, and there it is required.

fields.name: Fr:
fields.doc: French text lines, ended like En:; only a French game reads it, and there it is required.
